clips.title: The story
paras: Rot Hide gnolls and a rogue Scourge necromancer hold Fenris Isle in Lordamere Lake, off Silverpine Forest.

Fenris Keep once anchored Lordaeron’s military outpost on Fenris Isle. When the Scourge swept through northern Lordaeron, the garrison was slaughtered or fled into exile, leaving the island to the dead. Since then, Rot Hide gnolls have made it their stronghold, spreading a crude empire across the lake’s shores. The Forsaken of Silverpine Forest watch the island closely, fearing its entrenched inhabitants threaten their northern territories.
